title: Flat-term construction of the normalized section pullback comparison
statement: For normalized endpoint ScalarSectionData and a PullNormalized internal comparison, there is a section pullback comparison whose ordinary section equation holds and whose derived computation equation holds on flat-term K-flat representatives.

source.place: Tags 06YS, 06YY, 0D6D and 0G7E; flat-term part of parent transport proof step 8.

proof_origin.place: Flat-term representative construction before localization descent.

mathlib_searches.results: No existing declaration; the project interface only states the all-complex SectionPullNormalized property.

proof.text: Construct the derived section comparison by conjugating lam through the endpoint derived section models and the canonical derived pull comparisons. The map_preimage identity for whiskering by the section equivalence, followed by cancellation of the endpoint comparison isomorphisms, proves the conjugation realization equation required by the corrected derived computation lemma.
Apply the ordinary normalized square theorem to obtain e, then apply the flat-term derived computation theorem and package both equations as SectionPullNormalizedOnKFlat.

lean.statement:
theorem section_pull_transport_section_normalized_kflat {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y)
    (hcX : ScalarSectionNormalized a X cX) (hcY : ScalarSectionNormalized a Y cY)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X) (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam) :
    ∃ barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ derivedPullback Λ' f ≅ derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T,
      SectionPullNormalizedOnKFlat a f cX cY barLam
